The text generation is a byproduct of audio-to-text models, but the research questions are about audio modality understanding, benchmark correlation with preferences, and user interaction patterns - not NLG quality or techniques.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on evaluating Large Audio Models (LAMs) for speech understanding and user preference alignment, not on NLG tasks. While the models do generate text outputs, the research questions and methodology are centered around audio modality understanding, benchmark correlation analysis, and user interaction patterns rather than studying natural language generation itself. The extraction quality was generally good for the human evaluation and metrics sections.
